blocks.html:
Sustainability is an increasingly prominent theme in the research conducted at our University, which is committed to developing innovative solutions to address the global challenges of our time.

Through a multidisciplinary approach, our researchers explore new frontiers of knowledge to promote respect for the environment, the responsible use of resources, and a more equitable and inclusive future for all.

For information about projects addressing aspects related to the Sustainable Development Goals, please contact us at sosta@usi.ch
